text:
Create one continuous animated video from this complete KH2 Sora sprite. Keep the exact clean2D cel-shaded drawing style, face, spiky hair, costume, colors, chunky boots and weapon construction throughout. Fixed right-facing three-quarter camera, static pure white background, full figure and entire weapon always visible, generous margins. Animate the character running IN PLACE, centered at constant physical size, with no camera movement or scene change. This is animation-source footage for a sprite cycle, not a slideshow.




Show several complete natural running cycles: alternating near/far foot contacts, compression, passing, heel-off, toe-off, flight and opposite-foot contact. Coordinate hips, knees, ankles, small torso bob, shoulder motion, free-arm counter-swing, hair tips and slight red-cloth/chain lag. Feet should grip a common invisible ground during support and lift during flight; avoid sliding or pose jumps. Make the motion continuous and smooth, with the same repeating gait and stable character design on every frame.




The FAR/rear arm holds the Kingdom Key at the BACK shoulder as in the source: gold guard/gripping hand on screen-left, straight silver shaft slung over THAT SAME shoulder and BEHIND Sora's head, with the key head extending to screen-right and slightly toward the foreground. The head occludes the shaft. The NEAR/front arm is empty and swings naturally. Exactly two arms/hands. The gold guard, black grip, blue collar, shaft, crown teeth and pommel remain one connected rigid weapon of constant geometry/length; chain attached at pommel. No switching arms or weapon morphing. Preserve the source's rounded key-head cutouts. Keep it a flat2D game sprite with consistent polished shading, not a3D character. No scenery, effects, drawn ground, captions or speech. Generate the animated clip directly.
